balances.title: Fees & balances
balances.description: Our fees on this venue's sales, what we will pay you, and what you owe us.
balances.toDateNote: These count every sale so far. The dates below don't change them.
balances.payYouHelp: Online sales paid into Counterfoil's account. We keep our {platform} Counterfoil fee and the {gateway} online payment fee, then send you the rest.
balances.oweUsHelp: Our {platform} Counterfoil fee on money you took yourself: cash, counter sales, and online sales into your own account.
balances.neverNetted: We pay you and bill you separately. One is never taken off the other.
balances.bothTitle: Why is money owed both ways?
balances.bothSwitch: On {date} this venue moved its {provider} payments to {to}. Sales before that went into {fromLabel}. Sales after went into {toLabel}.
balances.bothCounter: Online sales into Counterfoil's account add to what we pay you. Cash and counter sales stay with you, so you owe us our fee on them.
balances.movementsHelp: Tap one to see how its fee was worked out.
balances.exported: Saved {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}
balances.emptyMessage: Nothing at this venue in these dates. Try other dates.

breakdown.title: Why this amount?
breakdown.vatNote: VAT goes to the government, so we take no fee on it.
breakdown.gatewayNoneNote: None. This money did not come through Counterfoil's account.
breakdown.platformHeld: Counterfoil received this money. We keep the fees and pay you the rest.
breakdown.operatorHeld: You took this money. You owe us our fee on it.
breakdown.refundPlatform: This refund came out of Counterfoil's account, so we pay you the whole refund less. Fees are not given back.
breakdown.refundOperator: You paid this refund from your own money. Nothing changes between you and Counterfoil. Fees are not given back.
breakdown.notYet: Not in a payout or fee bill yet
breakdown.fixedNote: The fee is fixed when the money is paid. Later changes to accounts or rates don't change it.

payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.description: Money we send to your bank from online sales paid into Counterfoil's account.
payouts.estimated: This amount can still grow until payout day.
payouts.schedule: We pay you {schedule}. Each payout is the sales since the last one, minus fees and refunds.
payouts.noDestination: Payouts are on hold until you add a bank account.
payouts.pendingDestination: We are checking your new bank details. Payouts go there once they are checked.
payouts.emptyMessage: Payouts show here once this venue takes online payments into Counterfoil's account.
payouts.detailSent: Sent {date}. It reaches your bank today.
payouts.linesHelp: Every payment and refund in it. Tap one to see its fees.

collections.title: Fee bills
collections.description: Bills for our fee on money you took yourself, and which ones you have paid.
collections.terms: Every Sunday we send a bill for the week before. Pay it within {days} days by bKash, card or internet banking.
collections.payBody: Our fee on {count, plural, one {# sale} other {# sales}} you took yourself, {from} to {to}.
collections.accruing: Still adding up. The bill comes {date}.
collections.pastDueBanner: {count, plural, one {A fee bill is} other {# fee bills are}} overdue. {amount} to pay.
collections.emptyMessage: Fee bills show here once this venue takes cash, counter or own-account payments.
collections.linesHelp: Every sale on this bill, and our fee on each one.
collections.notFound: We can't find that fee bill

settings.accountsDesc: Into Counterfoil's account or your own. Each venue can choose, and change it any time.
settings.counterfoilDisclosure: We take the payment and keep our {platform} Counterfoil fee + {gateway} online payment fee on each sale. We send you the rest {cadence}.
settings.ownDisclosure: Payments go straight to you. You owe us our {platform} Counterfoil fee on each sale, billed every week.
settings.defaultsDesc: Every venue uses these unless it has its own.
settings.perVenueDesc: A venue can use the same as all venues, or its own choice.
settings.keysBody: Payments will go into your own {provider} merchant account. Enter the keys {provider} gave you. We store them safely and never show them again.
settings.keysRemoved: {provider} keys removed. Payments go to Counterfoil's account again.
settings.switchBody: New payments will go to {to}. Payments already taken stay as they are, with the same fees.
settings.followDefaultTitle: Use the same as all venues at {venue}?
settings.followDefaultBody: {venue} will use the accounts set for all venues, and its own keys will be removed. Payments already taken stay as they are.
settings.bankDesc: Where Counterfoil sends the money we owe you.
settings.bankNone: No bank details yet. Payouts are on hold until you add them.
settings.bankSaved: Bank details saved. We will check them before the next payout.
settings.adminOnly: Only admins can change payment accounts and bank details.
settings.removeKeysBody: The keys will be deleted. If payments were going to your own account, they go back to Counterfoil's account, so no sale is refused.
